title: Recover the next JSON event after an interrupted encode
summary: Reads successive successful encodes from one public writer on a new thread and checks event boundaries.

change.description: The byte-output path now resets its reusable buffer on exit, including after an encode throws. An unrelated writer on the same thread should start with empty output.

notes: On the merged output class, a bytecode check found buffer and encoder cleanup on normal and exceptional exit. The two public interrupted-write claims remain open. [Merged class evidence](../../verification/merged-pr-links/s01-s50/repaired-guards.json)
